verdict.what_is_spun: India plus international crop protection businesses, consolidated into UPL Global Sustainable Agri Solutions Limited
verdict.reason: Unlock shareholder value by creating a focused pure-play crop protection platform, simplify group structure, enable independent capital raising, deleveraging and clearer value discovery for investors
verdict.insiders: UPL 2 promoters hold 71.56% post-scheme and voluntarily lock their entire stake for eighteen months from listing; Mike Frank to be CEO of UPL Global
verdict.hidden_value: UPL 2 holds the far larger asset: UPL Cayman alone had USD 4,187 Mn turnover and USD 1,599 Mn net worth versus UPL 1 standalone INR 53,313 Mn; world's second largest listed pure-play crop protection platform; parent deleverages
verdict.selling_pressure_why: 1:1 entitlement distributes UPL 2 shares to every UPL holder; newly listed entity with 28.44% public float
verdict.option_pricing_date: February 20, 2026 (valuation report and fairness opinion date)
verdict.read_next: Valuation Report and the abridged-prospectus disclosures for UPL 2 — revenue, PAT, EBITDA and transferred assets/liabilities
verdict.quote: The Scheme proposes to consolidate the India Crop Protection Business held in UPL SAS and Global Crop Protection Business held in UPL Cayman, under a single entity, creating a focused, pure-play crop protection platform.
